claims.text: Berylliosis: corticosteroid-sparing therapy (methotrexate or infliximab) is chosen as in sarcoidosis.
claims.quote: Corticosteroid-sparing therapy, such as with methotrexate (or infliximab), is selected based on a similar approach used in sarcoidosis.

claims.text: CI: doses > 5 mg/kg in moderate or severe heart failure;
claims.quote: The use of REMICADE at doses >5 mg/kg is contraindicated in patients with moderate or severe heart failure

claims.text: prior severe hypersensitivity to infliximab or murine proteins.
claims.quote: REMICADE is contraindicated in patients with a previous severe hypersensitivity reaction to infliximab or any of the inactive ingredients of REMICADE or any murine proteins

claims.text: Boxed warning: serious infections (TB, bacterial sepsis, invasive fungal, opportunistic) leading to hospitalization or death;
claims.quote: Increased risk of serious infections leading to hospitalization or death, including tuberculosis (TB), bacterial sepsis, invasive fungal infections (such as histoplasmosis) and infections due to other opportunistic pathogens.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Serious Infections and Malignancy

claims.quote: Discontinue REMICADE if a patient develops a serious infection.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Serious Infections and Malignancy

claims.quote: Use of TNF blockers, including REMICADE, has been associated with reactivation of hepatitis B virus (HBV) in patients who are chronic carriers of this virus.

claims.text: Severe hepatotoxicity: stop for jaundice or marked LFT rise.
claims.quote: Hepatotoxicity – severe hepatic reactions, some fatal or necessitating liver transplantation. Stop REMICADE in cases of jaundice and/or marked liver enzyme elevations.
Heart failure – new onset or worsening symptoms may occur.
Cases of leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and pancytopenia, some with a fatal outcome, have been reported in patients receiving REMICADE.

claims.text: Serious infusion reactions incl. anaphylaxis or serum sickness.
claims.quote: Hypersensitivity – serious infusion reactions including anaphylaxis or serum sickness-like reactions may occur.
Demyelinating disease – exacerbation or new onset may occur.
Lupus-like syndrome – stop REMICADE if syndrome develops.

claims.text: Test for latent TB before starting and periodically;
claims.quote: Prior to initiating REMICADE and periodically during therapy, patients should be evaluated for active tuberculosis and tested for latent infection
claims.locator: 2.9 Assessment for Latent and Active Tuberculosis

claims.text: treat latent TB first. Monitor for active TB even if the initial test was negative.
claims.quote: Perform test for latent TB; if positive, start treatment for TB prior to starting REMICADE. Monitor all patients for active TB during treatment, even if initial latent TB test is negative.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Serious Infections and Malignancy

claims.text: Test for HBV before starting; monitor carriers during and for months after.
claims.quote: Hepatitis B virus reactivation – test for HBV infection before starting REMICADE. Monitor HBV carriers during and several months after therapy.

claims.text: TNF blocker + abatacept or anakinra: more serious infections; combination not recommended.
claims.quote: The concomitant use of a TNF blocker and abatacept or anakinra was associated with a higher risk of serious infections in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA); therefore, the concomitant use of HUMIRA and these biologic products is not recommended in the treatment of patients with RA

claims.text: Bring vaccinations up to date before starting; no live vaccines during therapy.
claims.quote: Prior to initiating REMICADE bring pediatric and adult patients up to date with all vaccinations. Live vaccines or therapeutic infectious agents should not be given with REMICADE.
